verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these three kinds of purity.
Purity of body, speech, and mind.
And what is purity of body?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti.
verses.english: It’s when someone doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, or commit sexual misconduct.
And what is purity of speech?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti.
verses.english: It’s when someone doesn’t use speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical.
And what is purity of mind?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco anabhijjhālu hoti abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhiko.
verses.english: It’s when someone is content, kind-hearted, and has right view.
These are the three kinds of purity.”
